name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for my dental practice?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for my dental practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing AEO results can vary, but generally, initial improvements in visibility and direct answer appearances can be observed within 3-6 months. This depends on factors like the competitiveness of your local market, the current state of your online content, and the consistency of optimization efforts. Continuous monitoring and adaptation are crucial, as search engine algorithms and user query patterns evolve. AEO is an ongoing strategy, not a one-time fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial AEO results for dental practices can typically be seen within 3-6 months, influenced by market competition and consistent optimization efforts.
